steps:
Use a machine with no copy of DocProbePkg in %APPDATA%\twinBASIC\packages (a linked copy makes the bug go away).
1. Unzip DocProbePkg-twinpacks.zip (attached; bugs/replace-embedded-package-one-apply/ holds DocProbePkg-v1.twinpack and DocProbePkg-v2.twinpack, whose function DocProbeVersion returns 1 and 2). Open replace-embedded-package-one-apply.twinproj.
2. Embed v1: Project Settings > References > Available Packages > Import from file... DocProbePkg-v1.twinpack, tick it, Apply. Replace the body of Main with Debug.Print "DocProbeVersion=" & DocProbeVersion(), and press F5: the DEBUG CONSOLE shows DocProbeVersion=1.
3. Replace it with v2 under ONE Apply: in References untick DocProbePkg, then Available Packages > Import from file... DocProbePkg-v2.twinpack, tick it, and press Apply once.
4. See, in the DEBUG CONSOLE, only [COMPILER] Project settings updated: no compiler restart and no save. Press F5: it prints DocProbeVersion=1. Expected: 2.
Control: Apply after the untick, and again after the import and tick: each Apply restarts the compiler and saves, and F5 prints DocProbeVersion=2.
Re-measured on BETA 995 by `ide-test.bat --only packages` (the second and third tests, with the control; probes in test/ide/probes/packages).
